issues.text: A subset of a collective noun (a subset of the band) is not among the listed forms; it is read here as a plural part of a whole, with a distribution so that each member is a part, but the instructions do not say whether a subset relation between a group and a collective whole should instead be a portion or a part-whole without a distribution.
